title: Product canonical Skill source bundle
description: The existing Game SkillSourceBundle narrowed to host-portable canonical logical paths for recoverable product drafts and patches.
x-invariants: entrypoint and every file path are canonical slash-separated logical identifiers with no empty, dot, dot-dot or trailing-dot segment
file path identity uses ASCII case folding for collision detection; no two paths collide after folding
entrypoint equals exactly one file path with the same spelling and case
paths are logical identifiers and must never be normalized by a host filesystem
